notes: Background removal runs locally with rembg 2.x: uv tool install "rembg[cpu,cli]" --python 3.11 (installed 2026-10-25); the isnet-general-use model downloads to ~/.u2net on first use (about 180 MB, one time).
Retouch and layout use Pillow from the rembg tool environment (%APPDATA%/uv/tools/rembg/Scripts/python.exe on Windows) or ffmpeg; nothing is installed during a job.

steps.does: List every supplied image with the edits the customer asked for (cutout, background, exposure, color, crop, size) and the output files each one becomes.

Remove backgrounds with rembg i -m isnet-general-use <in> <out.png>, then look at each cutout on a dark and on a light background and repair lost handles, holes or leftover background with Pillow before going on.

Correct exposure and white balance gently so the product color looks true, then make every requested size, for example a white background square with the product centered at about 80 percent of the frame and a soft contact shadow, as JPEG quality 92; keep each transparent cutout as PNG.

steps.ask: A person checks every cutout edge and color at full size against the original before delivery.
